Howdy!

This is a thread for all of us who are royally screwed and can't
attend the EC in Prague. And for those who are in attendance, have
access to the Internet and feel pity for us left behind.

So, what I want is results (winners / finalists / decks) from the 4
big constructed events held on Thursday, Friday (LCQ), Saturday (EC1)
and Sunday (EC2). As well as general rumors and other treats.

Make me feel like I'm currently enjoying a Staro in Prague instead of
sitting here.

All the best!
And good luck to everyone who's trying to qualify for and to win the
EC.

I hate that I can't be there with you... *sob*

Regards

Messages.Author: Blooded Sand
Messages.Body:
Day one not sure, but day 2 was a guy from Slovakia called Jano with
a !Malk. the big cap bastards. Finals has a Arika deck, that from what
i could see, was packing mind rapes, baltimores, etc. He was preying
on the Slovak !Malk deck, who was preying on turbo Una, who was
preying on a !Tor weenie sleaze palla thing played by a French guy
(who has the SMOOTHEST table talk. Ever.) who was preying on !Malk 2.

Una got hurt early with Pentex, mind numb being used on the support
stars. Arika got bled hard and fast by the 1st !malk, and was down
very low when she played baltimore, after freaking from a mind rape on
one of the !malks preying on her. One of the top plays was the mind
rape victim getting torporised on a KS bleed, so Arika receives a
torporised minion, and has to send Arika to torpor. He never
recovered. Now there where 2 !Malks next to each other, the one who
ousted Arika being in a bit of trouble due to the foundation exhibit
powered Kines raining down on him. Best table talk line by the french
payer was when his Palla Grande had one counter left, and he says to
his prey (who i think was wondering if bleeding back would not useful
to cripple the !Tor deck) "See how friednly I am? I discard a Palla
grande". With a second Palla Grande in hand... Smoooth.

The Slovak !Malk quickly killed Una as there as no viable defence
there, and the !Tor killed the other !malk. Pentex then gets played by
the Jano (slovak) on Carlton, the only untapped minion the !torrie
has. He is bled down very low, and ousted the next turn. The final
took just under an hour or so i think. Due to a fifteen minute chat at
the start, actual play time was about 45 minutes.

Big woots to Jano, who I know is an awesome guy, and is gonna be
unlivable for a month or so ;) Deservedly so.

To everyone I met, my pleasure, and hope to see again. To the
Icelandic guys I played the last game at 2AM on sunday, thanks a
million for that game :) You know why!

PS someone lent me a narrow minds that I did not return,. please be so
kind as to email your adrees so I can mail it to you? thanks!

>> one of the !malks preying on her. One of the top plays was the mind
>> rape victim getting torporised on a KS bleed, so Arika receives a
>> torporised minion, and has to send Arika to torpor.
>
> How did the victim go to torpor? Blocking a bleed and then Coma or
> something like that? The minion shouldn't untap as usual given Mind
> Rape's text, right?

Baltimore Purge played by Arika. No Lasombra, so each player chose his or her
own victim. This player chose his Mind Raped vampire, naturally.

> Also, Baltimore Purge happens during untap, and Mind Rape control
> happens during Minion Phase, so it seems like it shouldn't matter
> anyway... Maybe I'm missing something.

Baltimore Purge and Mind Rape were played on the previous turn and then (on the
next turn), Purge goes off during the untap phase (sending Arika and the
still-tapped target of the Mind Rape to torpor). Then the Mind Rape goes off.

Messages.Author: Petri Wessman
Messages.Body:
Was a fun EC; the organizers did good, the place (christened "Khobar
Towers" by Team Finland early on :) wasn't luxurious in any way but
was well suited to the job, and I had a lot of fun in all the games I
played -- even in the ones where I got turbo-ousted by !Malks :). No
tense tables this year for me, everyone was pleasant and
sportsmanlike, very nice.

I played Settite + Baali Mute vote in the last chance tournament, a !
Tor + Daughters tap&bleed affair in EC day1, and an Osebo intercept
toolbox in the first chance tournament. None of them worked all that
well in those environments, only got some spare VPs and no game wins.
Oh well.

*Tons* of weenie decks this year, as noted by others too.

Extra thanks to Karel, Martin & Martina (assuming that's how the names
are spelled :) for organizing a very nice city tour for us before the
welcome party. Was much appreciated!

My only negative for the trip is the fact that I caught a flu+fever
combo near the end of the EC; floating around Sunday & Monday with a
mix of fever, sleep deprivation and alcohol made for some surreality,
especially when trying to play in the Sunday side tournament :/.

//Petri
